name: Imagination
overview: Scripture reveals that the imagination of the human heart is inherently evil from youth, reflecting the deep corruption of man's thoughts and desires (Genesis 6:5; 8:21). This sinful imagination leads to defiance against God’s commands and stubbornness, resulting in judgment and the removal of God's blessing (Deuteronomy 29:19-20). Nevertheless, the Lord is fully aware of human intentions and imaginations even before they come to pass, underscoring His sovereign knowledge over human plans (Genesis 11:6; Deuteronomy 31:21).
